title: Response Calculus for Spectral Simplicity and Joint Eigenvalue Densities
summary: We develop a perturbative response calculus for spectral problems obtained by changing the speed measure of a fixed symmetric energy form in a Gaussian environment. If Cameron--Martin translation acts by $μ_{x+f}=e^{κf}μ_x$, unitary transport identifies the varying $L^2$ spaces and produces a common-domain analytic family. For a positive eigenvalue $Λ$, the first-order operator is $-κΛ$ times the compression of multiplication by $f$ to the $Λ$-eigenspace; its eigenvalues are the derivatives of the analytic branches issuing from $Λ$.
